slides.title: Advanced cleft sentences
slides.subtitle: The reason why… / All I want… / It was not until…
goals: Use a range of cleft structures.

head: Structure
Example
rows: **The reason why** I left **is that** I needed a change.
**The thing that** surprised me **was** his honesty.
**What happened was that** the server crashed.
**It was not until** 2020 **that** I started teaching.
The place / person / time where / who / when
**The person who** helped me most **was** my aunt.

items.q: ___ I find most annoying is the noise.
It wasn't until I moved abroad ___ I appreciated my country.
The reason ___ she resigned is still unclear.
